unresolved_records.topic: Company geography and foundation-time typed representation
unresolved_records.evidence_summary: Company PRD requires Shenzhen-local structured filtering and names registration place as an identity signal; the accepted PRD-derived corpus also requires founded-after filtering, but the minimum field table freezes neither typed field name or subobject shape.
Shared minimum fields list industry and key_personnel; Company PRD marks both optional while making key_personnel structurally searchable when present.

unresolved_records.topic: Paper venue, professor_ids, keywords, and enriched-summary requiredness by lifecycle/path
unresolved_records.evidence_summary: Shared minimum fields are broader than PRD optionality, while Review makes title/year/venue/authors the thin-record minimum and defers enrichment.

unresolved_records.topic: Applicant is authoritative; owner semantics lack an authoritative PRD rule
unresolved_records.evidence_summary: Patent PRD explicitly defines applicant linkage; S2 names applicant/owner as representative alternatives without accepting owner edges.

unresolved_records.topic: Patent optionality versus shared minimum publication contract
unresolved_records.evidence_summary: Shared minimum lists inventor/type/date/link fields; Patent PRD marks them optional because approved export evidence is incomplete.
OpenSpec/shared wording says approved Shenzhen seed roster, while the explicit Professor Review removes system-side Shenzhen whitelist validation and treats admin seed admission as the boundary.

unresolved_records.topic: Shared four-state quality_status versus Paper six-state decision
unresolved_records.evidence_summary: Shared contract defines four canonical values; Paper Review explicitly retains partial and rejected in addition to those four.
OpenSpec requires allowed states, but the authoritative domain sources do not freeze a state set for each candidate relation.
